mcqs.question: What was the theme of World Patient Safety Day 2025, observed by the WHO on 17 September?
options: Safe care for every newborn and every child
mcqs.explanation: The 2025 theme of World Patient Safety Day was “Safe care for every newborn and every child.” “Ending Plastic Pollution” was the theme of World Environment Day 2025, while the Beijing Declaration detail relates to the Beijing+30 High-Level Meeting.

mcqs.question: Under the Swasth Nari–Sashakt Parivar Abhiyan, during which period were 13,944 health camps held in Andhra Pradesh?
mcqs.explanation: Andhra Pradesh conducted 13,944 health camps under the Swasth Nari–Sashakt Parivar Abhiyan from 17 September to 2 October. The period 17 September–16 October was associated with National Nutrition Month, not these health camps.

mcqs.question:
According to the patient-safety data associated with World Patient Safety Day, consider the following statements:
1. Harm affects 1 in 10 hospitalised patients.
2. Harm affects 4 in 10 hospitalised patients.
3. Harm affects 1 in 5 patients in outpatient care.
Which of the statements given above is correct?
mcqs.explanation: Statement 1 is correct: harm affects 1 in 10 hospitalised patients. Statements 2 and 3 change the stated figures and care setting; the outpatient figure is 4 in 10, not 1 in 5.

mcqs.question: Which body recommends Patient Advisory Councils (PACs) under its Global Patient Safety Action Plan?
mcqs.explanation: The WHO Global Patient Safety Action Plan recommends Patient Advisory Councils. NABH, the Society of Pharmacovigilance, India and the National Patient Safety Implementation Framework are related patient-safety references but are not the recommending body in this fact.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding important days and events observed or organised in 2025.

List-I
 a. International Literacy Day 2025
 b. Gandhi Jayanti
 c. Swachha Andhra Day
 d. Central Silk Board Foundation Day

List-II
 i. Every third Saturday in Andhra Pradesh
 ii. First Swachha Andhra Awards ceremony
 iii. Himachal Pradesh declared fully literate at Shimla
 iv. 20 September 2025, Bengaluru

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iii, b-ii, c-i and d-iv. International Literacy Day was linked with Himachal Pradesh being declared fully literate at Shimla; Gandhi Jayanti featured the first Swachha Andhra Awards ceremony; Swachha Andhra Day is observed every third Saturday in Andhra Pradesh; and the Central Silk Board Foundation Day was held on 20 September 2025 in Bengaluru.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The 79th session of the United Nations General Assembly was held in 2025.
Statement B: Sri Ramayana Sankharavam was a legal conclave held on 21 September in Vizianagaram.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are false. The relevant session was the 80th UNGA session in 2025, while Sri Ramayana Sankharavam was a legal conclave held on 20 September in Vizianagaram.

mcqs.question: Which organisation is specifically associated with the Indian patient-safety context along with the National Patient Safety Implementation Framework and NABH accreditation?
options: WHO Global Patient Safety Action Plan
mcqs.explanation: The Society of Pharmacovigilance, India is associated with the Indian patient-safety context in this reference. The WHO Global Patient Safety Action Plan and Patient Advisory Councils are global patient-safety references, while the Central Silk Board is unrelated to this issue.

mcqs.question: At Semicon India 2025, held on 2 September 2025, which of the following was presented?
mcqs.explanation: The Vikram 32-bit chip was presented at Semicon India 2025 on 2 September 2025. Project Sanjeevani and the First Swachha Andhra Awards are associated with other events, while Patient Advisory Councils relate to the Global Patient Safety Action Plan.
